sources.title: Microfinance and Credit Regulatory Authority Act, No. 9 of 2026

clauses.reference: Licensing provisions (section to be confirmed by counsel)
clauses.summary: Microfinance and money-lending business may be carried on only by a person licensed by the Microfinance and Credit Regulatory Authority.

clauses.reference: Borrower protection provisions (section to be confirmed by counsel)
clauses.summary: A lender must not obtain a borrower's signature on a blank or incomplete document.

clauses.reference: Borrower protection provisions (section to be confirmed by counsel)
clauses.summary: A lender must not enter into a credit agreement with a person under eighteen.

rules.title: Lender holds a licence from the Authority
rules.pass_detail: The lender's licence number is on file.
rules.fail_detail: No licence number is configured for this lender in Sri Lanka.

rules.title: No signature on a blank or incomplete agreement
rules.pass_detail: Every field of the agreement was complete when presented for signature.
rules.fail_detail: The agreement has blank fields. Complete them before the borrower signs.

rules.title: Applicant is at least 18
rules.fail_detail: The applicant is under 18. No credit agreement may be made.
